text: Liffey, also called Life, is an Irish heroine and a river goddess. She is the spirit of the River Liffey and of the plain of Mag Lífe that the river runs through. The Dindshenchas, the place-name poems of Ireland, tell that she died in the birth of her child in Aran. Her husband then died of grief. The river soon carried her name, and the Liffey still runs to the sea in Dublin.
